title: Correct work expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (1) must be W = mg(h + R/2) - (1/2)mv² or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Correct potential difference
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final answer for part (2) must be U_AB = [mv² - mg(2h+R)]/(2q) or an equivalent simplified form with correct sign.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem to relate gravitational work, electric work, and kinetic energy change from A to C.

title: Geometric height calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly calculate the vertical height difference between A and C as H = h + R sin30° = h + R/2.

title: Equipotential surface recognition
description: Important Criteria: The solution must recognize that B and C are on the same equipotential surface (same distance from O), giving φ_B = φ_C.

title: Potential difference relationship
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly relate U_AB to U_AC using the equipotential condition, establishing U_AB = U_AC.

title: Work-potential relationship
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use the relationship between electric work and potential difference: W_elec = -qU or equivalent.

title: Sign error in work definition
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student confuses 'work done by the ball to overcome electric force' with 'work done by electric field', missing the sign reversal.

title: Incorrect equipotential reasoning
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student assumes B and C have different potentials or incorrectly relates U_AB to other potential differences.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The solution shows dimensional analysis or unit verification for both final expressions.
